steps.content:
EDGE-02: He claims he can handle the situation himself. Says he'll eliminate BR-005 without starting a bigger fight.
EDGE-05: The internal conditions of a Black Ring are highly complex, and our Hypercube reserves are not infinite. The resource investment and operational risk for protection would be significant.

EDGE-02: His counterpoint is that neutralizing BR-005 would cover the Hypercube cost and even yield a profit.
EDGE-07: Even if we ignore the probability of failure, our analysis confirms BR-005 is a low-yield variant. Its anomalous readings are solely due to its fusion with the Apostles. A successful operation would not provide a meaningful return on investment.

steps.content: EDGE-02: If we don't let him eat it, what's to stop someone else from eating it?
steps.female_content: EDGE-02: If we don't let her eat it, what's to stop someone else from eating it?

steps.content: The communication pauses briefly.

EDGE-03: It'd be risky for the Underground Shepherd to surface. She only emerged for BR-002 due to its strength; she has never displayed any interest in a weaker Ring like BR-001.
EDGE-03: BR-005 is demonstrably weaker than BR-001. Therefore, the possibility is negligible.

EDGE-02: Huh. That's a thought.

EDGE-02: Regarding this, he also made a point. He says the Underground Sage moved the inheritance across a huge distance to trigger BR-005, and spent much effort guiding it back here.
EDGE-02: If it wasn't meant as a tribute to the Underground Shepherd, what was the point?

steps.content: The communication falls silent again for a moment.
EDGE-02: Oh, and we just got new intel. Looks like the enemy isn't just sitting on their hands after all.

EDGE-05: That changes the calculus. If any of those scenarios come to pass, we will face complications. I am in favor of revising both our strategy and our position.
EDGE-05: In fact, our initial judgment may have been compromised. This feels like external manipulation. I will initiate a full investigation after this meeting.

EDGE-05: Now, let's put the resolution on the table for discussion.
[Farland Outpost in WhiteSands]
Selyna has finally finished her letter. Before departing, she's going to send it to the director general of the Luminaris Society, her most trusted mentor.

My Dear Mentor and Director General,

I have safely rejoined my unit and now stand ready to enter the battlefield. Thank you for your swift reply; it arrived at the most crucial moment, allowing me to cast aside my foolish doubts and reclaim my true resolve. I was nearly led astray by that brat's poisonous words.
You are, of course, absolutely right. How could I have forgotten? The Furorians made their sacrifice willingly and nobly. If she truly had a drop of Furorian blood, if she possessed even a shred of an Outlander's consciousness, she would be proud of her mother's choice!
To defile their sacrifice with such words... I should have realized sooner. The Outland blood in her veins has run dry. She is nothing but a DisCity native.

A brat raised on DisCity water is tainted to the core. I should have killed her when I had the chance. After all, you taught us that even children who speak Disian belong in hell!

Now, all hesitation is gone. The final battle lies ahead. The wealth they have squeezed from us lies ahead. The world's Hypercubes lie ahead. As you have always taught me, this prosperity is rightfully ours—it was always meant to be—and we will seize it with all our might.

Only the path we walk can mend this broken world. Only our cause is truly just.

We will fight to the very end. We will make DisCity understand: Justice will prevail.

With her final encrypted message sent through the Mania dark web, Selyna gazes across the endless expanse of WhiteSands, a battlefield now scarred with streaks of black and crimson. She takes a deep breath, a wave of pure exhilaration washing over her. Even the indolence of her fellow warrior nearby no longer bothers her in the slightest.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Got anything else to say? Doesn't matter. I'm not lost anymore. My mind is set; only the final battle remains.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh? Really? I don't have much to add, honestly. Just... congrats, I guess? Good luck with that.

The wind sweeps across the white sands, lifting the Aurum Secretum chain in her hand. Fragments of Ash Crystal gleam with blinding intensity, fracturing her view of the distant city—a metropolis more prosperous and peaceful than Fraser—into a mosaic of shimmering shards.
As the chain sways, it hums with a resonant energy. Within that dazzling, power-laden light, she sees it: the city that rightfully belongs to her people.
There, she will erect a monument to her triumphs and raise a new future from the dust. At the end of this road paved in blood and sand, all farlanders will finally find a safe haven, free from fear.

Before departing, she recites the battle hymn one last time, a devout and solemn oath. The phantom of Nysa Sadikur is torn asunder and buried by the swirling sands, as if she had corrected that mistake.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Yes... No more doubt... We are righteous. This war is just. Victory will be ours.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Sands that buried my home, hear my words... Blizzards that stole my kin, gather at my fingertips...

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Confusion and fear are behind me. I stand here not for revenge, not for the past... but for hope. For the future...

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Catastrophes that shattered our land... forge the path forward for us...

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Today, we will use them to remake this world...
[Transition 2s]

In the distance, a blazing red cross ignites upon the colossal Apostle's chest. In response, the white sands below begin to flow like a spectral river, the howling wind spirals into a frenzy, and the very ground shudders.
As her chant swells, hordes of Apostles materialize from the void, their multitudes raising mutilated limbs to form a crushing tide of darkness.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: CHARGE—!!
[Scene Change] FAC Frontline
On the other side of the defensive fortifications, FAC soldiers are already in position.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Enemy incoming! All units on alert, prepare to engage!!
